name: Singed Scroll Fragment
summary: The Singed Scroll Fragment is one of three pieces of a destroyed scroll sought by Theldurin the Lost. Its recovery may help guard against Myzrael.

sections.title: A Scorched Piece
sections.body: Enraged Rock Elementals in the hills behind Theldurin the Lost carry the Singed Scroll Fragment. He seeks it with two other pieces of the Scroll of Myzrael, hoping the fragments can be joined again.

faq.q: What is the Singed Scroll Fragment?
faq.answer: It is one of three fragments from the destroyed Scroll of Myzrael.

faq.q: Where does the fragment come from?
faq.answer: Enraged Rock Elementals in the hills behind Theldurin the Lost carry it.
Theldurin the Lost asks for it alongside the Torn Scroll Fragment and the Crumpled Scroll Fragment.

faq.q: Why does Theldurin want the fragments?
faq.answer: He hopes to reattach them so the Scroll of Myzrael can be used against Myzrael.
